summary.text: Aimee Freeman is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 98 in Orleans Parish, first elected in 2019. The House's member page lists Aimee Adatto Freeman's committee assignments as Appropriations; Insurance; Retirement; the House Executive Committee; and the House Select Committee on Women and Children.

paragraphs.text: According to the Louisiana House member page, Aimee Adatto Freeman is a business strategist.
The page lists an M.B.A. from Tulane University and a B.A. from the University of Virginia.
It lists caucus affiliations with the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, and the Orleans Delegation.
